event_name: Date 29 September 2018 Time 19:09 2018 RUSSIAN GRAND PRIX 27 - 30 September 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 29), note that this document corrects an error in his previous report (document 19) and in accordance with Article 14.1.1 of the FIA International Sporting Code, determine this to be a 'new element'. Accordingly, our decision in document 21 is rescinded and is replaced by the following
fact: A 7th Turbo Charger (TC), 7th Motor Generator Unit Heat (MGU-H). Note that a 7th Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K) has not been used (contrary to what was reported in document 19).
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article 23.3 b).
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 31 2018 Russian Grand Prix Corrected Offence Car 28 Power Unit Elements
